name: browserglass-plugin-video-export
description: Reference frame-encoder plugin (docs/plugins.md): turns a recording's exported frames into a video file via a system ffmpeg. A real, separate npm project, deliberately excluded from the root pnpm-workspace.yaml, the same way examples/nextjs-demo is (see its README): its @browserglass/plugin-api dependency points at file:../../packages/plugin-api, which resolves through that package's real exports map exactly the way an actual plugin author's npm install @browserglass/plugin-api would once it is published.
